sentences.scenario: Confirm the audio works during an online lesson.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我听你; the learner repaired the hearing verb during the opening audio check.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè yào jiāo shuì.
sentences.english_hint: I have to pay tax every month.
sentences.source_note: Replaces repeated 一定 and vague 发钱 when explaining tax payments.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè dōu yào huán dàikuǎn.
sentences.english_hint: I have to repay my loan every month.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated payment descriptions; 还贷款 identifies the purpose and uses huán.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè cún yìdiǎn qián.
sentences.english_hint: I save a little money every month.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of 我一点存钱.

sentences.chinese: 我把钱转到银行账户里。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ qián zhuǎn dào yínháng zhànghù lǐ.
sentences.english_hint: I transfer the money into a bank account.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this correction for repeated vague 发钱 and incomplete account descriptions.

sentences.chinese: 我用工资的百分之十五还贷款。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yòng gōngzī de bǎifēnzhī shíwǔ huán dàikuǎn.
sentences.english_hint: I use fifteen percent of my salary to repay my loan.
sentences.scenario: Explain how much of your salary goes toward your loan.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我的还贷款是百分之十五分 and makes the percentage base explicit.

sentences.chinese: 五分之一是百分之二十。
sentences.pinyin: Wǔ fēn zhī yī shì bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
sentences.scenario: Express the same budget share as a fraction and a percentage.
sentences.source_note: Reinforces the learner's successful repair from 一分之五 to 五分之一.

sentences.chinese: 你的生活费是工资的几分之几？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de shēnghuófèi shì gōngzī de jǐ fēn zhī jǐ?
sentences.english_hint: What fraction of your salary goes to living expenses?
sentences.scenario: Ask someone about their monthly budget.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this question after repeated difficulty assembling proportion questions.

sentences.english_hint: My wife likes to save on spending.
sentences.scenario: Describe your wife's approach to shopping.
sentences.source_note: Shortens the corrected family contrast 我喜欢花钱，我太太喜欢省钱.

sentences.chinese: 我们打算去日本餐馆吃饭。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn qù Rìběn cānguǎn chī fàn.
sentences.english_hint: We plan to eat at a Japanese restaurant.
sentences.scenario: Tell someone about a planned restaurant visit.
sentences.source_note: Practices the analysis's future-plan correction while omitting the uncertain week.

sentences.scenario: Describe a restaurant experience from your travels.
sentences.source_note: Uses the analysis's correction of 去过在 and the learner's successful repair from 名牌 to 有名.

sentences.scenario: Mention your cars when discussing household expenses.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the confirmed 两个车 error in the learner's account of car expenses.

sentences.english_hint: My watch is a bit expensive.
sentences.scenario: Comment on the price of your watch.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of 我的手表一点贵.

sentences.english_hint: Could you make it a little cheaper?
sentences.scenario: Ask a seller for a lower price.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated attempts to ask for a lower price using 少一点.
